title: Silas and the Ember
author: Orsen Almeida
blurb: Marguerite Montrose, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
